info.title: ArcGIS REST APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 specification for ArcGIS REST APIs, split into subfiles using JSON `$ref` references.

## Directory structure

```
openapi.json                          ← this root file (entry point)
components/
  schemas/          ← shared data models (28 files)
  parameters/       ← shared query/path parameters (3 files)
  responses/        ← shared error responses (4 files)
  securitySchemes/  ← auth definitions (2 files)
paths/
  basemap/          ← Basemap Styles Service (6 operations)
  geocoding/        ← Geocoding Service (4 operations)
  places/           ← Places Service (5 operations)
  routing/          ← Routing Service (10 operations)
  geoenrichment/    ← GeoEnrichment Service (3 operations)
  elevation/        ← Elevation Service (2 operations)
  spatial_analysis/ ← Spatial Analysis Service (6 operations)
  portal/           ← Portal / Sharing API (8 operations)
  feature_service/  ← Feature Service (8 operations)
```

**Authentication:** ArcGIS token (OAuth 2.0) or API key via `token` query param or `Authorization: Bearer` header. Required for all write operations and for ArcGIS Online / Location Platform services.

**Official OpenAPI specs** (for Basemap and Elevation services) are available at the respective service `/specification/open-api-v3-0/` endpoints.

servers.description: Routing Service – Async job requests (VRP, LMD)

webadaptor.description: Web adaptor context or site name

servers.description: ArcGIS Server Services Directory – ArcGIS Enterprise

tags.name: Basemap Styles Service
tags.description:
Vector tile basemap styles (streets, imagery, terrain, creative).

**Base URL:** `https://basemapstyles-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/styles/v2`

**Official OpenAPI:** https://basemapstyles-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/styles/v2/specification/open-api-v3-0/

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/basemap-styles/

tags.name: Geocoding Service
tags.description:
Address geocoding, reverse geocoding, batch geocoding, and autosuggest.

**Standard:** `https://geocode-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World/GeocodeServer`

**Enhanced:** `https://geocode.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World/GeocodeServer`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/geocode/

**Pricing:** 20K free/month then $0.50/1K (not stored); $4/1K (stored)

tags.name: Places Service
tags.description:
Find businesses and POIs by radius or bounding box. Get detailed place attributes.

**Base URL:** `https://places-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/places-service/v1`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/places/

**Pricing:** 500 free searches then $8/1K

tags.name: Routing Service
tags.description:
Routes, directions, service areas, OD cost matrix, closest facility, VRP, last-mile delivery.

**Direct:** `https://route-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World`

**Async:** `https://logistics.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/routing/

**Pricing:** 20K free routes/month then $0.50/1K

tags.name: GeoEnrichment Service
tags.description:
Append demographic data and local facts to locations. Generate PDF/Excel reports. Query standard geographies.

**Base URL:** `https://geoenrich.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World/geoenrichmentserver/GeoEnrichment`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/geoenrichment/

**Pricing:** $1/1K attributes (Location Platform); 10 credits/1K (ArcGIS Online)

tags.name: Elevation Service
tags.description:
Topographic and bathymetric elevation at single or multiple points. Returns meters.

**Base URL:** `https://elevation-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/elevation-service/v1`

**Official OpenAPI:** https://elevation-api.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/elevation-service/v1/specification/open-api-v3-0/

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/elevation/

**Pricing:** 50K free/month then $1/1K

tags.name: Spatial Analysis Service
tags.description:
Hosted geoprocessing analysis. All tasks run asynchronously – submit a job, poll status, retrieve results.

**Base URL:** `https://analysis6.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/tasks/GPServer`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/analysis/

**Auth:** ArcGIS Online token + Publisher role required

tags.name: Portal Service
tags.description:
Manage users, groups, items, search, sharing, and OAuth tokens.

**ArcGIS Online:** `https://org.arcgis.com/sharing/rest`

**Enterprise:** `https://organization.example.com/{webadaptor}/sharing/rest`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/users-groups-and-items/

tags.name: Feature Service
tags.description:
Query, add, update, delete, and sync hosted or enterprise feature layers.

**URL pattern:** `https://{host}/{context}/rest/services/{folder}/{serviceName}/FeatureServer`

**Docs:** https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/feature-service/

get.description: Initiates a new session and returns a session token for tile requests.

Returns Mapbox GL / MapLibre GL Style JSON for a named ArcGIS basemap style.

**Available style names:** `navigation`, `navigation-night`, `streets`, `streets-night`, `streets-relief`, `streets-relief/base`, `community`, `outdoor`, `topographic`, `topographic/base`, `imagery`, `imagery/standard`, `imagery/labels`, `oceans`, `oceans/base`, `oceans/labels`, `hillshade/light`, `hillshade/dark`, `terrain`, `terrain/base`, `terrain/detail`, `light-gray`, `light-gray/base`, `light-gray/labels`, `dark-gray`, `dark-gray/base`, `dark-gray/labels`, `human-geography`, `human-geography/base`, `human-geography/detail`, `human-geography/labels`, `human-geography-dark`, `charted-territory`, `colored-pencil`, `nova`, `modern-antique`, `midcentury`, `newspaper`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Label language as BCP-47 tag (e.g. `en`, `fr`, `de`, `ja`). Default uses local language.

get.description:
Returns a Mapbox GL style based on OpenStreetMap data.

**Available styles:** `osm-style`, `osm-style-relief`, `osm-style-relief/base`, `navigation`, `navigation-dark`, `streets`, `streets-relief`, `streets-relief/base`, `streets-night`, `hybrid`, `hybrid/detail`, `light-gray`, `light-gray/base`, `light-gray/labels`, `dark-gray`, `dark-gray/base`, `dark-gray/labels`, `blueprint`.

get.summary: Get a custom basemap style by portal item ID
get.description: Returns the Mapbox GL style for a custom basemap style stored as a portal item.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Portal item ID of the custom basemap style.

get.summary: Get an ArcGIS basemap as web map JSON
get.description: Returns a web map JSON document for the requested ArcGIS basemap style. Use this to set a basemap in a web map.
Returns metadata about the service including available styles, supported languages, and worldviews.

get.summary: Geocode an address or place name
get.description: Converts text describing a location into candidate locations with coordinates and match scores. Supports single-line or component-based address input.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Preference location as JSON `{x,y}` or `lon,lat`. Biases results toward this area.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius in meters around `location` for preference bias.

parameters.name: outFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated attribute fields to return. Use `*` for all.

parameters.name: searchExtent
parameters.description: Bounding box to restrict search (JSON envelope or `xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax`).

parameters.name: magicKey
parameters.description: Magic key from a prior `/suggest` response. Retrieves a full candidate at no additional geocoding cost.

post.summary: Batch geocode a list of addresses (synchronous, up to 1,000)
post.description: Synchronously geocodes up to 1,000 addresses in a single request. Results are stored and incur stored-geocode pricing.

get.summary: Reverse geocode a coordinate to an address
get.description: Converts a longitude/latitude coordinate to the nearest address or place.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Point as JSON `{x, y, spatialReference}` or `lon,lat`.

get.description: Returns candidate suggestions for partial text input. Use the returned `magicKey` with `findAddressCandidates` to retrieve full coordinates at no additional credit cost.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius in meters around preference location.

get.summary: Search for places near a point
get.description: Returns places within a radius around a coordinate. Filter by category. Max 20 results per page.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Pagination token from a prior response.

get.summary: Search for places within a bounding box
get.description: Returns places within min/max longitude/latitude extent. Filter by category. Max 20 results per page.

get.summary: Get place details by place ID
get.description:
Returns detailed attributes for a specific place.

**Field groups (priced separately):**
- Place: `name`, `categories`
- Location: `location`, `additionalLocations:*`
- Address: `address:*`
- Details: `contactInfo:*`, `hours:*`, `rating:*`, `socialMedia:*`, `description`, `chains`
Returns all category IDs and labels, or a filtered subset. Category queries are free.
Returns the hierarchy and label for a specific category ID.
Finds the best path between two or more stops with turn-by-turn directions, total distance, and travel time. Supports walking, driving, trucking and other travel modes.

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: Stops as JSON FeatureSet, `lon,lat;lon,lat`, or address strings.

parameters.name: travelMode
parameters.description: Travel mode name or JSON (e.g. `Driving Time`, `Walking Time`, `Trucking Time`).

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Departure time as epoch milliseconds. Enables live traffic.

get.description: Creates polygons representing areas reachable within specified time or distance thresholds from one or more facilities.

parameters.name: facilities
parameters.description: Facility locations as JSON FeatureSet or `lon,lat;lon,lat`.

parameters.name: defaultBreaks
parameters.description: Space-delimited break values (minutes or distance). Example: `5 10 15`.

get.description: Finds one or more nearest facilities from incidents based on travel time or distance.

parameters.name: incidents
parameters.description: Incident locations as JSON FeatureSet or `lon,lat;lon,lat`.

parameters.name: defaultTargetFacilityCount
parameters.description: Nearest facilities to find per incident.

get.description: Calculates travel cost between every origin and every destination. Returns a cost table.

parameters.name: origins
parameters.description: Origin locations as JSON FeatureSet or `lon,lat;lon,lat`.

get.summary: Snap GPS track points to roads (direct/sync)
get.description: Snaps a series of GPS track points to the underlying road network for map-matching and track correction.

parameters.name: inputFeatures
parameters.description: GPS track points as JSON FeatureSet.

post.description: Submits an async routing job. Returns a `jobId` to poll. Use for large inputs exceeding the direct API limits.
Submits an async service area (isochrone) generation job.

post.summary: Submit Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) async job
post.description: Determines effective route assignments for a fleet visiting multiple stops. Supports time windows, capacities, depots, and break schedules.
Determines the most effective routes for a fleet to minimize operating cost for a last-mile delivery scenario.

get.description: Returns current status of an async routing job. Poll until `jobStatus` is `esriJobSucceeded` or `esriJobFailed`, then retrieve results from the `results` links.

post.description: Appends demographic facts and local statistics to input locations (points, polygons, or standard geographies). Returns the requested data variables for each feature.

studyAreas.description: JSON array of study area objects. Can be points (with optional buffer), polygons, or named place IDs. Example: `[{"geometry":{"x":-117.196,"y":34.057}}]`.

analysisVariables.description: JSON array of variable IDs. Example: `["AtRisk.ACSTOTPOP","AtRisk.ACSOMALES"]`.

dataCollections.description: JSON array of data collection names (returns all variables in each collection).

post.summary: Generate a demographic or business report
post.description: Generates a PDF or Excel report summarising demographics, tapestry market segments, business data, or market potential for a study area.
Returns standard geography features and IDs for different geographic levels (country, state, county, ZIP code, census tract, block group, etc.).

geographylayers.description: JSON array of geography layer IDs. Example: `[{"id":"US.States"}]`.

geographyids.description: JSON array of geography feature IDs to retrieve.

geographyquery.description: Text to search within geography names.

get.summary: Get elevation at a single coordinate
get.description: Returns TopoBathy elevation (land topography + ocean bathymetry) for a single coordinate. Values are in meters.

post.description: Returns elevation values for up to 100 coordinate pairs in a single request.
Groups point features into polygon bins using a fishnet, hexagon grid, or custom polygons. Calculates counts and optional statistics per bin. Runs asynchronously.

outputName.description: Name for the output hosted feature layer.

pointLayer.description: Input point layer as JSON FeatureCollection, item URL, or feature service URL.

polygonLayer.description: Polygon layer to aggregate into. If omitted a grid is generated.

post.summary: Find hot spots (Gi* spatial clustering, async)
post.description: Uses the Getis-Ord Gi* statistic to identify statistically significant spatial clusters of high values (hot spots) and low values (cold spots).

outputName.description: Name for the output hosted feature layer.

analysisLayer.description: Input feature layer URL or JSON.

analysisField.description: Numeric field to evaluate for clustering.

post.description: Creates buffer polygons around input features at specified distances. Supports multiple ring distances, dissolve options, and distance units.

outputName.description: Name for the output hosted feature layer.

field.description: Field whose values define per-feature buffer distances.

sideType.description: Which side of a line to buffer.

post.description: Combines two feature layers using a geometric overlay (Intersect, Union, Erase). Returns a new layer with combined attributes.

outputName.description: Name for the output hosted feature layer.

post.summary: Summarize features near each input feature (async)
post.description: Calculates statistics on features within a specified distance or travel time of each input feature. Useful for site analysis, proximity queries, and service area summaries.

outputName.description: Name for the output hosted feature layer.

get.description: Returns current status of a submitted spatial analysis job. Poll until `jobStatus` is `esriJobSucceeded`. Retrieve results by following URLs in the `results` object.
Returns the portal as seen by the authenticated user, including org details, default extent, featured content group IDs, and token service URLs.

get.summary: Search portal items, groups, or users
get.description: Full-text search across portal items using Lucene-style query syntax for field-specific filtering.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Lucene-style query. Example: `type:"Feature Service" AND tags:transportation`.

get.description: Returns the profile for a specific portal user including their groups, role, and user type.
Returns details about a portal group including description, members, and content sharing settings.
Returns metadata for a portal item including title, type, description, URL, tags, and access level.

post.summary: Add an item to the portal
post.description: Creates a new portal item. The item can be a file upload, a URL reference, or inline content (JSON, text, etc.).

url.description: URL of the service or resource the item represents.

text.description: Item JSON content (for items without a file).

post.description: Changes the sharing level of an item. Can share publicly, to the organization, or to specific groups.

groups.description: Comma-separated group IDs to share with.

post.description: Exchanges client credentials for an ArcGIS access token. Supports `client_credentials` (app token), `authorization_code`, and `refresh_token` grant types.

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI registered with the app.

get.description: Returns the root resource of a feature service including layer list, capabilities, spatial reference, sync settings, and supported operations.
Returns features from a layer matching the specified attribute, spatial, or temporal criteria.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: SQL WHERE clause to filter features. Use `1=1` to return all features.

parameters.name: spatialRel
parameters.description: Spatial relationship between input and feature geometry.

parameters.name: outFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names. Use `*` for all fields.

parameters.name: resultOffset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: orderByFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names + optional `ASC`/`DESC` to sort.

parameters.name: groupByFieldsForStatistics
parameters.description: Fields to group by for statistical queries.

parameters.name: returnCountOnly
parameters.description: If true, returns only the feature count.

200.description: Query results as a feature set.

post.summary: Query a feature layer (POST – for long queries)
post.description: Same as GET query but via POST to support large geometry inputs and complex WHERE clauses exceeding URL length limits.

200.description: Query results as a feature set.

post.summary: Add new features to a layer
post.description: Inserts one or more new features into a feature layer. Returns per-feature success/error results including newly assigned object IDs.

features.description: JSON array of features to add. Each has `geometry` and `attributes`.

post.description: Updates one or more existing features. Each feature must include its `OBJECTID`. Supports partial updates.

features.description: JSON array of features to update. Each must include `attributes.OBJECTID`.

post.description: Deletes one or more features by object IDs or a WHERE clause filter.

where.description: SQL WHERE clause for bulk delete.

post.summary: Apply edits across multiple layers in a single transaction
post.description: Performs adds, updates, and deletes across multiple layers atomically. The `edits` parameter specifies layer-level edit objects. Supports rollback on failure.

edits.description: JSON array of edit objects per layer. Each has `id` (layer ID), `adds`, `updates`, `deletes`.

post.summary: Apply edits to a single layer
post.description: Performs adds, updates, and deletes on a single feature layer in one atomic operation.

adds.description: JSON array of features to add.

updates.description: JSON array of features to update.

BearerToken.description: ArcGIS token or OAuth 2.0 access token passed in the Authorization header.

TokenParam.name: token
TokenParam.description: ArcGIS token passed as a query parameter. Accepted by all ArcGIS REST services.

layerId.name: layerId
layerId.description: Layer index within the service (0-based integer).

SpatialReference.description: Spatial reference specified as a well-known ID or well-known text.

Geometry.description: ArcGIS geometry (point, polyline, polygon, envelope, or multipoint).

Feature.description: A geographic feature with optional geometry and attribute map.

FeatureSet.description: A collection of features returned by a query.

ArcGISError.description: Standard ArcGIS REST API error envelope.

JobStatus.description: Async job status returned from submitJob operations.

JobRef.description: Immediate response when an async job is submitted.

EditResult.description: Per-feature result of an add/update/delete operation.

BasemapStyleResponse.description: Mapbox GL / MapLibre GL Style Specification JSON.

PlaceDetails.description: Detailed attributes for a single place.

PortalItem.description: An ArcGIS portal item (map, layer, application, file, etc.).

PortalSelf.description: Portal self resource — the portal as seen by the authenticated user.
